author: reek
body: Hand-authored card interpretations for the covered Old School pool. Rather than parse Oracle text at runtime, each card's behaviour is written directly as Ability/Effect IR -- the engine's execution vocabulary -- with errata and modern rules folded in. Where a card's exact behaviour exceeds the current IR the interpretation is a best-guess approximation (noted inline); precision is not the goal here, coverage and playability are. The whole library is dumpable (dump-library) for bulk human review later.
